+package bench
+
+// Config holds configuration for a single benchmark run.
+type Config struct {
+	// Rate is the target request rate in requests per second.
+	Rate int
+}
+
+// LinearGenerator produces a sequence of Config values with linearly
+// increasing request rates, starting at a lower bound and incrementing
+// by a fixed step until the upper bound is exceeded.
+type LinearGenerator struct {
+	curr  int
+	step  int
+	upper int
+	done  bool
+}
+
+// NewLinearGenerator creates a LinearGenerator that starts at lower
+// and increments by step on each call to Next, stopping when the
+// current value exceeds upper.
+func NewLinearGenerator(lower, upper, step int) *LinearGenerator {
+	g := &LinearGenerator{curr: lower, step: step, upper: upper}
+	if lower > upper || step <= 0 {
+		g.done = true
+	}
+	return g
+}
+
+// Next returns the next configuration and true while the generator
+// has not been exhausted. When exhausted it returns (nil, false).
+func (g *LinearGenerator) Next() (*Config, bool) {
+	if g.done {
+		return nil, false
+	}
+	cfg := &Config{Rate: g.curr}
+	g.curr += g.step
+	if g.curr > g.upper {
+		g.done = true
+	}
+	return cfg, true
+}
